results.corrected_title: Challenger: AI-cited job cuts hit 2026 monthly low in October
results.corrected_summary: Challenger, Gray & Christmas reported 43,994 announced US job cuts in October 2026. That is up 2% from September and down 71% from October 2025. AI was cited for 1,265 cuts, the lowest monthly total of 2026. Year to date, AI has been cited for 121,401 cuts (about 20% of the total), and Market/Economic Conditions now leads with 130,531.
key_facts: October cuts: 43,994, up 2% from September's 43,281 and down 71% from 153,074 in October 2025
AI cited for 1,265 cuts in October, the lowest monthly total this year
AI cited for 121,401 cuts year to date, about 20% of all cuts
Market/Economic Conditions leads year to date with 130,531 cuts, overtaking AI
Year-to-date total cuts are 617,189, down 44%
results.issues: 'Lowest October since 2023' not explicitly seen; page title says three-year low.

results.corrected_title: AMD posts record Q3: data center up 97%, Q4 guide about 17bn

Non-GAAP diluted EPS $2.09 (+74%); GAAP EPS $1.46
Client and Gaming $3.7B, -8% y/y (Client +7% to $2.9B, Gaming -40% to $773M)

results.corrected_title: Palantir Q3 revenue up 96%, but stock dipped early as contract value growth slowed
results.corrected_summary: Palantir reported Q3 2026 revenue of $2.313B (+96% y/y) on Nov 2. US commercial revenue of $984M (+148%) topped US government revenue of $953M (+96%) for the first time. It raised its FY2026 revenue guide to $8.530-8.534B and guided Q4 to $2.649-2.653B. The stock fell about 2% in early trading on Nov 3 as total contract value growth slowed to 6% y/y, but MarketBeat's price box showed it closing up on the day.
key_facts: Q3 revenue $2.313B, +96% y/y and +20% q/q
US commercial $984M (+148%) passed US government $953M (+96%) for the first time
FY2026 guide raised to $8.530-8.534B; Q4 guide $2.649-2.653B
Total contract value growth slowed to 6% y/y from 49% in the prior quarter (per MarketBeat)
Stock fell over 2% early on Nov 3 but rebounded; MarketBeat price box showed +3.48% at the close
results.issues: Headline 'stock fell' only true for early trading; stock closed up per MarketBeat. Contract growth claim only from MarketBeat.

results.corrected_title: Anthropic study of 207,049 Claude sessions shows how researchers use AI
results.corrected_summary: Anthropic analysed 207,049 consumer-plan sessions (128,914 on Claude and 78,135 on Claude Code) from Aug 2 to Sep 30, 2026, plus a survey of 528 scientists, mostly in the life and health sciences. Data analysis made up 33.7% of Claude sessions and 48.1% of Claude Code sessions, against 27.6% of researchers' time. Anthropic estimates AI could take on 27-52% of the researcher time needed for a new study, with a median of 38%.
key_facts: 207,049 sessions, Aug 2 to Sep 30, 2026 (128,914 Claude, 78,135 Claude Code)
Survey of 528 scientists, mostly in life and health sciences
Data analysis is 33.7% of Claude sessions and 48.1% of Claude Code sessions, vs 27.6% of researcher time
AI could take on 27-52% of research time, median 38%
About 40% of respondents expect AI to run full research projects on its own by 2030
